# M3

> Every page of the M3 module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [M3 consent and fetching](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3): The M3 operations grouped by use case.
- [Fetch the full consent artefact](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-consent-fetch): Also known as: Consent Fetch.
- [Acknowledge a consent notification](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-consent-hiu-on-notify): Also known as: Consent HIU On-Notify.
- [Initiate a consent request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-consent-request-init): Also known as: Consent Init Request.
- [Check the status of a consent request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-consent-request-status): Also known as: Consent Request Status.
- [Health Information Request Status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-health-information-request-status): Polls the current status of a previously made health information request, by
- [Notify the gateway that data was received](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-hiu-data-flow-notify): Also known as: HIU Data Flow Notification.
- [Request a patient's health information](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-hiu-health-information-request): Also known as: HIU Health Information Request.
- [The consent artefact detail, fetched by artefact id](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-on-consent-fetch): The artefact itself, in answer to a fetch by artefact id.
- [The consent request was accepted, with its request id](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-on-consent-request-init): Carries the consent request and the request id. Store the request id: it is how a later notification is tied back to the request you made.
- [The patient's decision, sent to the record holder](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-on-consent-request-notify-hip): The same decision sent to the system that holds the records, with all care context references.
- [The patient's decision, sent to the requester](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-on-consent-request-notify-hiu): On a grant, carries every consent artefact id created against the request, with the request id. On a denial, carries the denial, with `reason` set if the gatewa
- [The consent manager reports the state of a consent request you asked about.](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-on-consent-request-status): The consent manager reports the state of a consent request you asked about.
- [Acknowledgement of a health information request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-on-health-information-request): Carries the transaction id, the request id and the current status. This is an acknowledgement, not the records. The records arrive at the data push URL you supp
- [The encrypted health data itself, pushed to the URL you supplied](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/endpoints/m3-on-health-information-transfer): The actual encrypted FHIR bundle. The HIP Data Bridge posts this directly to
- [M3 Consent and fetching errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/errors): What M3 Consent and fetching returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
